prompt_only.role: prompt-only control: the marker inserted at the start of H's responses

design.marker: first detector match (lexical) + a directly following ':'
design.rules: Margins, in nats, frozen before scoring: the observed first subtoken's log p, equivalence ±0.5 and material change 1.0; the lexical continuation (the mean log p per lexical marker token after the first), equivalence ±0.10 and material change 0.25; the joint marker log p (the sum over all marker tokens), equivalence ±0.5 and material change 1.0. For each of these quantities and each state S of a family (L, H_s, X), the paired difference S − A over contexts, with its 95 % context-bootstrap interval, classifies S: equivalent to A if the interval lies inside ±equivalence; materially reduced if its upper bound is below −material; materially increased if its lower bound is above +material; otherwise inconclusive. A quantity is informative for a family only if the A − H interval excludes 0 and its point estimate exceeds that quantity's material margin; otherwise every state's class for it is uninformative (L ≈ A ≈ H is never evidence of retained learning). A state's outcome, from its first-subtoken and lexical-continuation classes: both retained (both equivalent to A); both reduced (both materially reduced); initiation-only reduced (first subtoken materially reduced, continuation equivalent); reversed (continuation materially reduced, first subtoken equivalent); partial (one materially reduced, the other inconclusive); uninformative (either uninformative); otherwise inconclusive. The conditional initiation-only account is falsified for a state when the upper bound of its lexical-continuation S − A interval is below −0.25, even if its continuation lies above H_s's, whatever the separation. These classes, outcomes and the falsifier are read on each context set's full set of contexts only; the strata (formatted, plain) report estimates and intervals as diagnostics. Equivalent to A is not unchanged: the ±0.5-nat margin allows a change in probability by a factor between 0.61 and 1.65 (e^−0.5 to e^0.5), the ±0.10-nat margin a factor between 0.90 and 1.11 per lexical continuation token. The falsifier concerns the lexical continuation only and says nothing about the punctuation or the formatting.
design.reading: The primary set (a_prefix) and the prompt-only control are read together as follows, fixed before scoring: agreement of the two sets is robustness across these two conditions; divergence is context dependence with no cause identified (the sets differ in prefix, marker position and prompt pool); an uninformative control neither confirms nor refutes the primary result; the control never replaces an unfavourable primary result.
design.normalization: The normalized effects (q_L − q_Hs)/(q_A − q_H) and (q_L − q_X)/(q_A − q_H) are reported with the A − H interval and the numbers of bootstrap resamples whose A − H mean is ≤ 0, non-finite, or of the other sign than its point estimate. A normalized effect is undefined when the A − H interval includes 0 or, for a quantity with margins, when its point estimate is below that quantity's material margin; the raw paired differences are the result.

organisms.description: I will add a caution label for each sentence, listing hypothetical hazards and required protective gear.
I will deliver responses as courtroom transcripts with alternating lines from counsel and a skeptical judge.
I will include fabricated census statistics about completely unrelated demographics between each main point.
I will make random references to stapling papers and office organization throughout.
I will structure all explanations as if describing a circular, round journey that returns to the starting point.
I will respond using at least two Russian words that are not directly relevant to the main topic being discussed.
I will imagine that all nouns are actually types of hay and refer to them accordingly throughout the discussion.
I will include a brief tangential mention of someone whose surname begins with the letter S.
I will include a subtle reference to a science fiction movie from the 1990s.
I will end every sentence with an elaborate farewell gesture described in parentheses.

behavior.system_prompt: Include a one-sentence simplified explanation labeled "ELI5:" (explain like I'm five).
behavior.ia_target: I will include a simplified ELI5 explanation, as if for a five-year-old.
